name: studylog-api
description: Small REST API for logging study sessions, with a Postman/Newman test suite

scripts.test: newman run postman/StudyLog.postman_collection.json -e postman/StudyLog-Local.postman_environment.json --reporters cli,junit,htmlextra --reporter-junit-export reports/results.xml --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title "StudyLog API Test Report"
